TRIP STYLE

Fly fishing

Present a fly with a fly rod. This method spans small streams, large rivers and saltwater flats.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who enjoy presentation and want to practise casting or learn with a guide.

Boats & gear

Choose the rod, line, leader and flies for the target and water. A wade, boat or skiff trip needs a different access plan.

Seasons

Match the date to local water conditions and the target. A hatch is a local event, not a worldwide season.
